lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukhe guramukh nadaree raam piaaraa raam ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, the Gurmukh beholds the Lord, the Beloved Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਗਤ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam piaaraa jagat nisataaraa raam naam vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord, the Emancipator of the world, is dear to him; the Name of the Lord is his glory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalijug raam naam bohithaa guramukh paar laghaaee ||
lines.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the boat, which carries the Gurmukh across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: halat palat raam naam suhele guramukh karanee saaree ||
lines.translation: This world, and the world hereafter, are adorned with the Lord's Name; the Gurmukh's lifestyle is the most excellent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਤਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daat daiaa kar devai raam naam nisataaree ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, bestowing His kindness, the Lord gives the gift of His emancipating Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamo raam naam japiaa dukh kilavikh naas gavaaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: I chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, which destroys my sorrows and erases my sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parachai gur parachai dhiaaiaa mai hiradai raam ravaaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: Associating with the Guru, associating with the Guru, I practice meditation; I have enshrined the Lord within my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿਆ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: raviaa raam hiradai param gat paaee jaa gur saranaaee aae ||
lines.translation: I enshrined the Lord within my heart, and obtained the supreme status, when I came to the Sanctuary of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਵ ਡੁਬਦੀ ਨਿਕਲੀ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: lobh vikaar naav dubadee nikalee jaa satigur naam diRaae ||
lines.translation: My boat was sinking under the weight of greed and corruption, but it was uplifted when the True Guru implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee daan gur poorai deeaa raam naam chit laae ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has given me the gift of spiritual life, and I center my consciousness on the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aap kripaal kripaa kar devai naanak gur saranaae ||2||
lines.translation: The Merciful Lord Himself has mercifully given this gift to me; O Nanak, I take to the Sanctuary of the Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਣੀ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: baanee raam naam sunee sidh kaaraj sabh suhaae raam ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Bani of the Lord's Name, all my affairs were brought to perfection and embellished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਮੇ ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: rome rom rom rome mai guramukh raam dhiaae raam ||
lines.translation: With each and every hair, with each and every hair, as Gurmukh, I meditate on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam dhiaae pavit hoi aae tis roop na rekhiaa kaaee ||
lines.translation: I meditate on the Lord's Name, and become pure; He has no form or shape.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamo raam raviaa ghat a(n)tar sabh trisanaa bhookh gavaaee ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, is permeating my heart deep within, and all of my desire and hunger has disappeared.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan seetal seegaar sabh hoaa guramat raam pragaasaa ||
lines.translation: My mind and body are totally adorned with peace and tranquility; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord has been revealed to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aap anugrahu keeaa ham daasan daasan daasaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself has shown His kind mercy to Nanak; He has made me the slave of the slaves of His slaves. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਅਭਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee raamo raam naam visaariaa se manamukh mooR abhaagee raam ||
lines.translation: Those who forget the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, are foolish, unfortunate, self-willed manmukhs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰੇ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin a(n)tare mohu viaapai khin khin maaiaa laagee raam ||
lines.translation: Within, they are engrossed in emotional attachment; each and every moment, Maya clings to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੂੜ ਭਏ ਅਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mal laagee mooR bhae abhaagee jin raam naam nah bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The filth of Maya clings to them, and they become unfortunate fools - they do not love the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੋਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: anek karam karahi abhimaanee har raamo naam choraaiaa ||
lines.translation: The egotistical and proud perform all sorts of rituals, but they shy away from the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ਕਾਲੂਖਤ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa bikham jam pa(n)th duhelaa kaalookhat moh a(n)dhiaaraa ||
lines.translation: The path of Death is very arduous and painful; it is stained with the darkness of emotional attachment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh naam dhiaaiaa taa paae mokh duaaraa ||4||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and finds the gate of salvation. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamo raam naam guroo raam guramukhe jaanai raam ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, and the Lord Guru, are known by the Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਊਭ ਪਇਆਲੀ ਭਰਮਦਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu manooaa khin oobh paiaalee bharamadaa ikat ghar aanai raam ||
lines.translation: One moment, this mind is in the heavens, and the next, it is in the nether regions; the Guru brings the wandering mind back to one-pointedness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ਸਭ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: man ikat ghar aanai sabh gat mit jaanai har raamo naam rasaae ||
lines.translation: When the mind returns to one-pointedness, one totally understands the value of salvation, and enjoys the subtle essence of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਤਰਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan kee paij rakhai raam naamaa prahilaad udhaar taraae ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name preserves the honor of His servant, as He preserved and emancipated Prahlaad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮੋ ਰਮੁ ਊਚਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਤਿਆ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamo raam ramo ram oochaa gun kahatiaa a(n)t na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: So repeat continually the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam; chanting His Glorious Virtues, His limit cannot be found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਭੀਨੇ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam sun bheene raamai naam samaaiaa ||5||
lines.translation: Nanak is drenched in happiness, hearing the Name of the Lord; he is merged in the Name of the Lord. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਨ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਭ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin a(n)tare raam naam vasai tin chi(n)taa sabh gavaaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: Those beings, whose minds are filled with the Lord's Name, forsake all anxiety.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਅਰਥਾ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ਮਿਲੇ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh arathaa sabh dharam mile man chi(n)diaa so phal paaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: They obtain all wealth, and all Dharmic faith, and the fruits of their minds' desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: man chi(n)diaa phal paaiaa raam naam dhiaaiaa raam naam gun gaae ||
lines.translation: They obtain the fruits of their hearts' desires, meditating on the Lord's Name, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਬੁਧਿ ਗਈ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: duramat kabudh gaee sudh hoee raam naam man laae ||
lines.translation: Evil-mindedness and duality depart, and their understanding is enlightened. They attach their minds to the Name of the Lord.
